subject.title: fix(msteams): read file attachments on Teams channel messages (team GUID + channel fallback + thread-reply URL)

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal text/html stubs trigger best-effort Graph media lookup by default after the normalization repair, or should this fallback stay default-off behind an explicit msteams option?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the default changes existing deployments from tag-gated lookup to Graph lookup for text/html stubs, which is a product and compatibility tradeoff around permissions, latency, diagnostics, and message context.

options.title: Repair and accept automatic fallback
options.body: Normalize the MIME check, keep the PR's automatic non-personal fallback, and rely on best-effort Graph failures to degrade without blocking message handling.

options.title: Require default-off opt-in
options.body: Ask the author to adopt the config-gated shape so existing installs keep the current mention-only protection unless operators enable extra Graph reads.

options.title: Reconcile with the group-chat PR first
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether the channel and group-chat fallback fixes should land together or as separate scoped repairs.

recommendation.title: Repair and accept automatic fallback
recommendation.body: Normalize the MIME check, keep the PR's automatic non-personal fallback, and rely on best-effort Graph failures to degrade without blocking message handling.
